肌酸在 2026 年徹底走出運動營養的框架。今年的成長來自女性、中高齡族群和一般保健買家，這個轉變正在改變架上產品的樣貌。即飲式肌酸已經出現了，用雙腔包裝防止化合物在溶液中降解。

這個工程設計我覺得真的很聰明，但我還是推薦粉狀，因為即飲格式每公克價格是粉狀的好幾倍，而這個分子本身的原料成本低到不行。

Thorne Creatine 守第一，9.4 分，贏在檢測嚴謹度。它有 NSF Certified for Sport 認證、第三方驗證，Thorne 的製造標準在保健品業界領先幅度很明顯。

Momentous 的 9.2 用 Creapure，德國產的單水肌酸，純度規格是市面上最嚴的，想要原料來源有名有姓、追得到源頭的人，這個可追溯性值得那個溢價。

Optimum Nutrition Micronized 的 9.1 是性價比答案，我自己吃的就是這個。同一個分子、有送檢、價格是精品選項的零頭。Transparent Labs Creatine HMB 的 8.9 多加了 HMB，但這個組合在已受訓練者身上的證據強度普通。Legion 的 8.6 收尾。

劑量建議一直都很簡單，每天五公克，任何時間吃都可以，重點是持續。負荷期是選配，跳過大概晚三週達到飽和而已。

highlights.title: 單水肌酸不管哪一家都是同一個分子

highlights.title: 每天五公克、持續吃，這就是全部的協定
highlights.body: 時間點無所謂，負荷期是選配，吃更多也沒有額外效果。跳過負荷期大概要多三週才達到飽和，換來的簡單省事我覺得很划算。

highlights.title: 即飲肌酸很聰明，但太貴
highlights.body: 雙腔包裝確實解掉了溶液中降解的真實問題。可是每公克價格拉到粉狀的好幾倍，而這個分子的生產成本很低，所以在價值這一項我給粉狀更高分。

highlights.title: 我自己買的是 Optimum Nutrition
highlights.body: 微粒化單水肌酸、有第三方檢測、價格是高階品牌的零頭。9.1 分，有效成分跟前兩名一模一樣，省下來的錢剛好夠你穩定吃一整年。

en.commentary: Creatine is the fastest-growing supplement category in the market right now, up 17.1 percentage points in the latest popularity survey, and the growth is coming from women and older adults well outside the traditional gym audience. That shift matters for how you should buy. Thorne Creatine holds first at 9.4 because it is NSF Certified for Sport, the micronised powder dissolves without grit, and the label states exactly one ingredient. When a category grows this fast, the number of products with unverified sourcing grows with it, and third-party certification is the cheapest protection available. Momentous at 9.2 uses Creapure monohydrate and publishes lot testing, and it is the one I recommend to anyone competing under drug-testing rules. Optimum Nutrition Micronized at 9.1 is the value answer and the tub most people should actually buy, because creatine monohydrate is a commodity and the premium brands are selling verification on top of it. The Texas Attorney General's heavy metal probe into plant protein powders is a useful reminder here: contamination risk travels with the raw material supply chain, and creatine sourced through unverified channels carries the same category of risk. Buy certified, take five grams daily, skip the loading phase, and ignore every form other than monohydrate.

highlights.title: Monohydrate is the only form worth buying
highlights.body: Creatine HCl, buffered forms and liquid variants all charge more for a molecule that performs the same or worse. Five grams of monohydrate daily is the protocol with the evidence behind it, and everything else is packaging.

highlights.title: Third-party certification is the real product at the top
highlights.body: Thorne is NSF Certified for Sport and Momentous publishes lot testing. In a category growing 17 percentage points a year, verified sourcing is what you are actually paying the premium for.

highlights.title: Optimum Nutrition is what most people should buy
highlights.body: Creatine monohydrate is a commodity and ON delivers it micronised, tested and at the lowest sensible price here. At 9.1 it is the tub I would put in most kitchens without hesitation.

highlights.title: Skip the loading phase
highlights.body: Loading fills muscle stores faster and gets you to the same place as five grams a day within a month, with more stomach upset along the way. Start at the maintenance dose and stay there.

Thorne Creatine 守第一，9.4 分，因為它有 NSF Certified for Sport 認證、微粒化粉末溶解後沒有顆粒感，而且成分表上就一樣東西。一個品類成長這麼快的時候，來源不明的產品數量也會同步增加，第三方認證是最便宜的保護。

highlights.title: 值得買的只有單水合

highlights.title: 頂端產品真正在賣的是第三方認證
highlights.body: Thorne 有 NSF Certified for Sport，Momentous 公開批次檢驗。在一個一年漲 17 個百分點的品類裡，你多付的錢買的就是可驗證的來源。

highlights.title: 多數人該買的是 Optimum Nutrition
highlights.body: 單水合肌酸是大宗原料，ON 給你微粒化、有檢驗、價格又合理的版本。9.1 分，我會毫不猶豫地把它放進多數人的廚房。

highlights.title: 負荷期可以直接跳過
highlights.body: 負荷期只是讓肌肉儲存量更快填滿，一個月後跟每天五克走到同一個位置，中途卻更容易腸胃不適。直接從維持劑量開始，一路吃下去就好。
